The '''Odos systems''' were a group of [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]<ref name="CSWE-Odos">{{CSWECite|II|404|Odos}}</ref> situated within the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> They contained the [[Odos system/Legends|Odos system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and its [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Odos]],<ref name="CSWE-Odos" /> which was surrounded by [[Gas/Legends|gas]] [[Cloud/Legends|clouds]].<ref name="PoT">''[[Planet of Twilight]]''</ref>

The Odos systems were located near the [[Chorios systems]].<ref name="CSWE-Odos" /> They were also located near the [[Exodo system/Legends|Exodo system]] and the [[Spangled Veil Nebula/Legends|Spangled Veil Nebula]].<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Most [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that wished to make a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] from this region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] departed from the far side of the Odos systems.<ref name="CSWE-Odos" />

In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> while at [[Exodo II]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] were attacked by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] from the nearby [[Antemeridian sector/Legends|Antemeridian sector]].<ref name="PoT" /> They lost their pursuers by flying the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] through the gas clouds of Odos and the fringes of the Spangled Veil Nebula.<ref name="PoT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Odos systems first appeared in ''[[Planet of Twilight]]'', a [[1997]] novel authored by [[Barbara Hambly]].<ref name="PoT" /> They were first described as a group of star systems by the [[1998]] reference book ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', written by [[Stephen J. Sansweet]].<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Odos system, and therefore at least a part of the Odos systems, in grid square R-7.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
